description: This file defines the NotesParseRule class, which extends BaseRule, and provides a preParse method to modify panel data related to note fields such as related document IDs, revision IDs, and file links within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: NotesParseRule
classes.description: A class that customizes the parsing of note-related fields in the SuiteCRM application by overriding the preParse method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the NotesParseRule class; currently does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Iterates through panels and their rows and columns, replacing specific column values based on pattern matching to standardize field references related to notes.
